law: Nothing executes until it proves itself.
execution_rule: A cloud may host execution, but no cloud owns the governing state.
failure_rule: Loss of one cloud must not authorize unproven execution in the other.
witness_rule: Every cross-cloud continuity transition must produce independently stored matching receipt hashes.
authority_rule: Cross-cloud health and evidence are read-only by default; mutations require an explicit local permit at the destination boundary.
